name: sherpa
description: Develop like a sherpa: composable /frame, /shape, and /implement skills — one per layer (macro, shape, build) — plus /review, /triage, and /restory skills for reviewing, triaging, and reconstructing story context, with bundled codebase-explorer/review/build subagents and adversarial pressure at every boundary. The user composes the workflow; sherpa offers the tools. Nothing runs unasked, nothing persists unless you call /persist. Project-agnostic; extend with project packs.
